name: DiffDock
summary: Diffusion-based protein–small-molecule pose prediction with separate model checkpoints.

steps: Choose the maintainer's conda or Docker instructions and pin the repository commit or container digest; distinguish the current DiffDock-L model from the older publication model.
Check GPU compatibility and inspect environment.yml or Dockerfile before installation in an isolated location.
Review checkpoint download locations, cache use, and license before first inference; do not assume the code installation includes all weights.
install.verify_note: Run a maintainer-provided example only after the selected model checkpoint and compute requirements are confirmed.

notes: The repository README says the default model is DiffDock-L; cite and compare the correct model version in research use.
